Players Committee errata card image of [[ComScan Detection (PC Errata 2018 E card)]], marked "E", as it stood in the [[Holotable]] image set when the PC's GitHub repository [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable swccgpc/holotable] was first committed on 8 July 2018 (commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b]). The PC later replaced it: [[ComScan Detection (PC 2022 D-E1 card)]].

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Hoth-Dark/large/comscandetection.gif</code> at commit 022435b ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Hoth-Dark/large/comscandetection.gif file]). Uploaded unchanged. SHA-256 <code>1ff29d3c0559f31168301ef3ed8f66dfbf4a157d005d52842457dabecd4a37fd</code>.

The card image may be older than 8 July 2018: that is the date of the repository's first commit, which imported the existing image set.

Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee). It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
